X.note: Terrain map, coin stack against a single coin, wagon and canal icons, and clean callouts with a good color hierarchy. Wagon vs canal reads fast. The canal coin is oddly flat, and the 'ACTUAL' badges are noise. The wagon label sits slightly off its stack.

Y.note: Plain glossy cubes on a dark grid with no context. The 13% label is faded and overlaps its cube, which makes the text hard to read. The callout boxes cover the cubes. The three values (7%, 6%, 13%) have no clear relationship, and the cube sizes don't match the numbers. The first label is also cramped.

why: X shows a place and a clear quantity comparison with legible labels, while Y has overlapping, faded text and cubes that don't explain what the numbers mean.
top_fix_for_weaker: Fix the 13% label so it is fully opaque and doesn't overlap its cube, and place the labels clear of the cubes. Make cube heights proportional to the values (6, 7, 13). Add a short caption naming what each cube is (extra stair area, savings, total cost), and replace the empty grid with a recognizable building or floor-plan context.
